retrievalProfile.description: A theatrical heraldic composition featuring a central metallic mask flanked by mythical supporters inside a heavy ornate gold frame with distressed block lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, weathered metal hockey-style mask is flanked by a crowned lion and a unicorn in a mock-heraldic style. The entire scene is set against a dark purple smoky background, encased in a thick, three-dimensional ornate gold picture frame. Bold, distressed orange block text sits at the top, while a curved ribbon banner at the bottom contains secondary script text.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical heraldic arrangement around a central mask
High-contrast gold frame bordering a dark, saturated interior
Distressed, heavy typography balancing the ornate frame
Mythical creatures interacting with the central focal point
coreInvariants: Weathered metal mask as the centerpiece

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The mask is centered; the lion and unicorn are scaled to fit the height of the mask; the frame occupies the outer 15% of the canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central metal mask acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top bold text, move down to the central mask, follow the supporters outward, and rest on the bottom banner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark purple smoke fills the gaps between the central figures and the frame.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background and text; high value in the frame highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and blackletter-influenced block type
letterConstructionRules: Rough, distressed edges simulating weathered paint
characterSpecificRedesigns: Inner counters are small and geometric
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy distressed block type for impact paired with a refined script for elegance.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, weathered feel of the main title.
Matches the heraldic theme for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark purple smoky background inside a thick, ornate 3D gold rococo frame. In the center, place a weathered metal mask flanked by a yellow heraldic lion and a white unicorn. Add an orange ribbon banner at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in distressed orange block letters at the top and the subtitle in white script on the bottom ribbon.

verificationChecks: Is the frame thick and ornate?
Is the mask centered between the two creatures?
Is the top text distressed and bold?
Is the background smoky and purple?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the frame looks metallic and heavy.
Check that the text is legible despite the distress.
Verify the symmetry of the heraldic elements.
Confirm the purple background provides enough contrast for the figures.
recipe.reuseFormula: Ornate Frame + Heraldic Supporters + Central Icon + Distressed Block Type = Heavy Metal Aesthetic
